newsitem.title: USA: Syria's Assad recovers from surgery - U.S. official.
newsitem.headline: Syria's Assad recovers from surgery - U.S. official.

text.p: Syrian President Hafez al-Assad had a recent operation but has recovered "well," State Department Middle East negotiator Dennis Ross said on Thursday.
Ross gave no details about the nature of the operation and made his comment in answer to questions about whether Assad's health would affect U.S. efforts to restart Syrian-Israeli peace talks.
He was asked if he accepted reports that Assad was in failing health. He said he did not because "we have had reports that he had surgery but he recovered well."
Ross, speaking to reporters after meeting U.S. Jewish leaders, said the United States is trying to come up with a formula that would allow Israel and Syria to resume their talks.
"We have no basis yet," he said, adding that Washington would keep trying.
